500.$description: Height of the smallest control: chips at size XXS. Below the 44px tap minimum, so only for things that are not tapped on their own.

600.$description: Height of a very small control: chips at size XS.

800.$description: Height of a small control: the button pill at size S. Numbers at 25x the pixel value, like Space and Radius, not 12.5x like Icon.

1000.$description: Height of a medium control: the button pill at size M.

1200.$description: Height of the tap target wrapped around a small or medium control. Clears the 44px minimum, so button sizes S and M stay tappable while their pills stay 32 and 40.

1400.$description: Height of a large control: the button pill at size L, which is tall enough to be its own tap target.

1500.$description: Height of a compact list row: listItem Filled Compact and Outlined Compact. Fixed, with clipping, so a subtitle does not fit.

1800.$description: Height of a full list row: listItem Filled and Outlined. Fixed, with clipping.

sm.$description: The lip on an outlined control at sizes S and M, built as a heavier bottom border because there is no fill to darken. Positive because it is a border weight, not an offset. Roughly half elevation.lip.sm and tuned by eye: a solid stroke at border/strong reads far heavier than a 15% inner shadow, so matching the numbers would over-weight it.

lg.$description: The same outlined lip at size L, against the 1px border on the other three sides.

width.$description: Thickness of the focus ring. Aliases the heavy border stroke so the ring stays in step with the system. Pair with border/focus for the colour and focus.offset for the gap.

page.$description: The root canvas of every screen.

surface.$description: The fill of anything raised off the page: cards, sheets, modals, bubbles.

input.$description: The fill of an editable field at rest.

inverse.$description: A light block on the dark page, for tooltips and toasts that need to stand apart.

scrim.$description: The dimming layer behind a modal or sheet.

floating.$description: A translucent surface for menus and popovers that float over content.

stacking.$description: An additive lift for toasts and notifications sitting above a dark surface.

primary.$description: Default text colour; use it unless a lower emphasis is deliberate.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: subtitles, helper copy, metadata.

tertiary.$description: Lowest readable emphasis, for timestamps and counts beside something else.

placeholder.$description: Prompt text inside an empty input, readable enough to clear AA.

disabled.$description: Text on a control that cannot currently be used.

inverse.$description: Dark text sitting on a light or vivid fill.

onaccent.$description: Text sitting on any accent bold fill.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text inside body copy.

linkhover.$description: Hover colour for a link; unused on this touch-only product.

warning.$description: Text flagging a limit or an expiry.

primary.$description: Fill of the one main action on a screen.

onprimary.$description: Label and icon colour on a primary fill.

secondary.$description: Fill of a supporting action beside the primary one.

onsecondary.$description: Label and icon colour on a secondary fill.

disabled.$description: Fill of a control that cannot currently be used.

destructive.$description: Fill for delete or remove actions; no such control exists in this product.

ondestructive.$description: Label colour on a destructive fill.

pressed.$description: Press overlay for light surfaces; unused, because press in this system is geometry rather than colour.

pressedinverse.$description: Press overlay for dark surfaces; unused for the same reason.

primaryhover.$description: Hover fill for a primary control; unused on a touch-only product.

primaryactive.$description: Pressed fill for a primary control; unused, press does not change colour.

secondaryhover.$description: Hover fill for a secondary control; unused on a touch-only product.

secondaryactive.$description: Pressed fill for a secondary control; unused, press does not change colour.

destructivehover.$description: Hover fill for a destructive control; unused.

destructiveactive.$description: Pressed fill for a destructive control; unused.

default.$description: Standard edge on cards, inputs and dividers.

strong.$description: A heavier edge for separators that must read at a glance.

focus.$description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring.

error.$description: Edge of a field that failed validation.

success.$description: Edge of a field confirmed correct.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen card, tab or option.

surface.$description: Fill of a chosen card, tab or option.

border.$description: Edge that pairs with highlight surface, never used alone.

indicator.$description: The filled mark inside a checked checkbox or radio.

gloss.$description: Diagonal light band on a done planNode, inset so the base colour shows as a ring. Alias of alpha light-40.

bold.$description: Solid fill reporting a correct answer.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a success fill.

subtle.$description: Tinted panel behind a correct result.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle success panel.

bold.$description: Solid fill reporting an answer that was on the right track but incomplete.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a partial fill.

subtle.$description: Tinted panel behind a partial result.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle partial panel.

bold.$description: Solid fill reporting a wrong answer.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on an error fill.

subtle.$description: Tinted panel behind a wrong result.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle error panel.

bold.$description: Solid fill flagging something that needs attention.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a warning fill.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle warning panel.

bold.$description: Solid fill for neutral information that is neither right nor wrong.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on an info fill.

subtle.$description: Tinted panel behind an informational message.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle info panel.

bold.$description: Solid brand violet for brand moments rather than actions.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a bold brand fill.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle brand panel.

bold.$description: Decorative green for streaks and stat chips.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a bold green accent.

subtle.$description: Tinted green panel behind a stat.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle green accent.

bold.$description: Decorative coral for category tags and illustration accents.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a bold coral accent.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle coral accent.

bold.$description: Decorative blue for secondary category tags.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a bold blue accent.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle blue accent.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a bold magenta accent.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle magenta accent.

bold.$description: Solid fill for PRO badges and upgrade prompts.

onbold.$description: Text and icons on a PRO fill.

onsubtle.$description: Text and icons on a subtle PRO panel.

accent.$description: Duplicate of pro bold, kept because older references use this name.

primary.$description: Knowie's body violet; only for the mascot, never for interface.

eyeoutline.$description: The outline stroke giving Knowie's eyes and body depth.

flame.$description: The flame in streak illustrations; it is orange despite its former name.

width.$description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

offset.$description: Gap between a control's edge and its focus ring.

instant.$description: Press feedback and anything that must read as immediate.

fast.$description: Small elements appearing or leaving in place.

slow.$description: Large travel: sheets and full-screen transitions.

exit.$description: Dismissal of anything that entered at base.

breathing.$description: Knowie's ambient idle loop; zero in reduced mode means do not run it.

enter.$description: Decelerates; for anything arriving on screen.

standard.$description: Decelerates and accelerates; for anything moving in place.

linear.$description: No easing; for spinners and progress bars only.

l.$description: Celebration numbers only; too wide for a 390px screen.

m.$description: Celebration numbers only; too wide for a 390px screen.

s.$description: The only Display step that fits a short word at 390px.

xs-regular.$description: A small heading that should sit quietly.

l-regular.$description: The longest and most important body string on a screen.

s-regular.$description: Decorative only; below the 14px readable minimum.

s-bold.$description: Decorative only; below the 14px readable minimum.
